1.consolidated_definition: Desyerbar en torno: Sustantivo que designa el acto de desyerbar sólo alrededor de una planta para depositar el abono aproximadamente a dos pies del tronco.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Fertilization around the plant: Noun that denotes the act of fertilizing only around a plant to deposit fertilizer approximately two feet from the trunk.
